name: Maine Audubon Day Camps
description_short: Maine Audubon runs nature day camps at Gilsland Farm Audubon Center in Falmouth (Greater Portland) and Fields Pond Audubon Center in Holden (Greater Bangor). It offers summer camps and February/April vacation camps for preschool and elementary-age children.
refund_policy_summary: Summer camp: full refund if Maine Audubon cancels the session. If you cancel before June 1, you get a refund minus a $30 processing fee per registration. No refunds for cancellations after June 1. Vacation camp: no refunds within 14 days of the start date. Cancellations more than 14 days ahead are refunded minus a $30 fee. COVID-related cancellations are refunded minus a $30 fee.

warnings: No 2027 sessions, dates or prices are posted yet. The summer programs say 'More information coming January 2027' and the vacation camps say 'More information coming November 2026'.
The only schedule linked is the 2026 Summer Day Camp Schedule PDF, which is for a past season and was not recorded.
There are two locations: Gilsland Farm in Falmouth and Fields Pond in Holden. The address recorded is Gilsland Farm (headquarters).
The ages don't match: the EEA section says camps are for 'children ages 3-9', but Fields Pond Raptors is for rising 4th-6th graders, who are likely older than 9. Age max was left blank.
The summer refund policy gives two different years: 'after June 1, 2027' and 'before June 1, 2026'. The summary assumes June 1 of the camp year.
Programs: Sprouts (ages 3-5), Saplings (ages 4-5) and Discovery Kids (K-3) at Gilsland Farm; Songbirds (rising 1st-3rd) and Raptors (rising 4th-6th) at Fields Pond.
Scholarship contact: (207) 781-2330 ext. 224, scholarships@maineaudubon.org. The scholarships are partial and for Maine residents.
